PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
INTRODUCTION OF AN ORDINANCE FOR THE 3-YEAR SEWER SERVICE CHARGE INCREASE
It is recommended that the City Council 1) open the public and protest hearing; 2) hear all oral and written testimony; 3) close the public and protest hearing; 4) determine the number of protests received; 5) introduce Ordinance No. 08-873, amending Section 4.10.040 entitled Calculation of Charge of Chapter 4.10 (Sewer Charges) to increase the sewer service charge for the next three (3) years.

It is recommended that the City Council: 1) open a public hearing; 2) take public testimony; 3) close public hearing; 4) waive the reading of Ordinance No. 08-874 and read by title only; and 5) introduce Ordinance No. 08-874, adopting smoke shop zoning regulations within the City.

CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
